bagPolicy.summary: Large bags and backpacks cannot enter concerts; smaller bags are subject to search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Croke Park recommends public transit and lists off-site city-centre parking; surrounding streets are residential.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
